item.title: Only 15% Of Malaysian Seniors Ageing Well, Dementia Rate Up: NHMS 2025
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
NHMS 2025 reveals a poor state of health among Malaysian seniors: only 15% ageing well, dementia prevalence rose to 10%, and high prevalence of NCDs (diabetes: 39%, hypertension: 73%, high cholesterol: 76%). About 68% live with at least 2 chronic diseases. The post Only 15% Of Malaysian Seniors Ageing Well, Dementia Rate Up: NHMS 2025 appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: Corporate Benefit Schemes Can’t Override Doctors’ Clinical Decisions, Says MMA
item.description:

item.title: Malaysia Short Of Nearly 6,000 Vets, Says DVS
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Malaysia is facing a severe shortage of nearly 6,000 veterinarians, says the DVS, as the country only has 2,600 active vets compared to 8,500 needed. The ratio of vets to people in Malaysia is 1:13,700, far worse than the international standard of 1:5,000. The post Malaysia Short Of Nearly 6,000 Vets, Says DVS appeared first on CodeBlue .
